final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS dp FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(dp) AS mdp FROM r), k AS (SELECT r.rc, r.dp, r.dp - m.mdp AS ex FROM r, m WHERE r.dp > m.mdp) SELECT AVG(rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(dp) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(ex) AS avg_excess FROM k
